signals.angle: Thread: agents are getting IDs the way people got KYC. Connect it to your own Agent ID, shado.ai, and ask whether agent identity becomes mandatory before agents can hold money.
signals.summary: Know Your Agent gives AI agents verifiable digital identities linked to the business or person they represent, what they are authorised to do, and whether actions stay within approved limits. Built on W3C Verifiable Credentials and AvatarLabs agentic wallet tech, with a cross-border pilot across the Middle East, Africa, China and ASEAN, results going to ITU and IEEE standards discussions.
signals.title: Zetrix AI and CAICT launch Know Your Agent (KYA) service for verifiable AI agent identity
